title: server.ts
description: Opens the store (`DB`, in memory by default) and serves the router on `127.0.0.1` at `PORT` (default 5310), with the library's time zone from `TIME_ZONE` (default `America/New_York`); an unknown time zone stops it at start-up with a message. The router runs the outbox's relay once at start, so events left undelivered are delivered. Stops cleanly on SIGINT or SIGTERM.
